u0: No client's order is currently outstanding and nothing is owed from earlier steps; the shop is caught up. When a client arrives, their order must still be taken, their food fetched and prepared at the stove, and the prepared dish given to them. Nothing has been served yet this episode, but any serve completed now returns things to this fully settled situation.
u1: A client's order has been taken and that order still has to be prepared at the stove and then served. The client is waiting, so nothing else counts until their food is prepared and handed over. Once the prepared dish is served, the shop returns to being caught up.
u2: Food has been prepared at the stove and still has to be handed to the waiting client whose order was taken. That client is waiting on the finished dish, so the remaining step is the serve. Delivering it restores the caught-up situation.
u3: A client has arrived at the counter and their order has not been taken yet, so they are waiting to be dealt with. Their order still needs taking, and the food then needs fetching, preparing at the stove and serving. Turning to the client and taking the order starts this off.
u4: A client has arrived whose order has not been taken, and food has already been prepared at the stove. Only a client who has ordered can be served, so the order must be taken first; then the prepared dish can be handed over. Both the taking of the order and the eventual serve are still owed.
u5: A client's order has been taken, and meanwhile a new client has arrived at the counter with an order not yet taken. The first client needs food prepared and served, and the new client's order must be taken and then filled in the same way. Several obligations are stacked up, and each client's order, preparation and serve must still be completed.
u6: A client's order was taken earlier, and no food has been prepared for it yet. The order still needs food prepared at the stove and then served to that client. Until that is done, the outstanding obligation remains.
u7: A client is waiting whose order has not been taken, and an earlier client's taken order is still unfulfilled. Both need attention: the earlier order must be prepared and served, and the new client's order must be taken and then filled. More than one obligation is open at once.
